findings.question: Does the current LB implementation/config reveal a mechanism that can make admin/stats on 8081 unresponsive independently of data traffic?
findings.summary: [code file=load-balancer/LoadBalancer.cpp smell=blocking-stats-client-read tests=fail] Yes. The stats service has a dedicated thread, but accepts one client and performs a blocking read() before handling/responding; a client that connects to :8081 and sends no request can therefore hold that sole stats thread and leave later admin/stats requests unanswered, independently of LB data traffic. I would set a receive timeout or use nonblocking/poll-based request handling with bounded reads so a stalled client cannot monopolize the stats listener. Tests could not be validated: the invoked test command reported Go is not installed, and does not establish whether the C++ suite passes.
